edges.notes: Users access static portal through CloudFront
CloudFront routes request to S3 website bucket
Portal interacts with API Gateway for dynamic backend operations
API Gateway reads/writes user metadata and tracking logs in DynamoDB
Portal invokes Service Catalog to provision data science environments
Portal invokes Lambda functions for AI/ML processing tasks
Lambda invokes Translate SDK for automated translation
Lambda invokes Comprehend Medical SDK for entity detection
